title: Automotive Vehicles — Pneumatic Tyres for Passenger Car Vehicles — Diagonal and Radial Ply
qco_name: Pneumatic Tyres and Tubes for Automotive Vehicles (Quality Control) Order
source_authority: Bureau of Indian Standards / MoRTH Gazette

clauses.title: High-Speed Endurance Performance Test on Test Drum
clauses.text: Clause 4.2 & Annex F (High-Speed Drum Test): The tyre is run on a 1.7 m diameter test drum at ambient temperature 38±3°C under 80% rated load for 34 hours through progressive speed steps up to its rated speed symbol (e.g. T = 190 km/h; H = 210 km/h; V = 240 km/h). Criteria: No tread separation, ply separation, cord chunking, or bead failure.

clauses.title: Tread Wear Indicators (TWI) Height Requirement
clauses.text: Clause 4.3 (Tread Wear Indicators): Every passenger car tyre shall have at least 6 tread wear indicator ribs molded across the tread. The height of the TWI ribs shall be 1.6±0.1 mm above the base of the tread groove.
